DEPARTMENT OF VETERANS AFFAIRS NETWORK CONTRACTING OFFICE 21 (NCO 21) 
Description: THIS IS A PRE-SOLICITATION NOTICE FOR A REQUEST FOR QUOTE (RFQ). 
VA Pacific Island Health Care System has an future need for combustion and tuning services for Boilers at Veterans Affairs Sierra Nevada Health Care System (VASNHCS) in Reno, NV . 
Solicitation Number 36C26126Q497 for this effort will be posted to SAM.GOV (https://sam.gov) on or about March 17, 2026. This solicitation will contain all necessary specifications and information necessary to quote the project. 
See solicitation for when questions must be submitted. 
Quotes are tentatively scheduled to be due on Tuesday, March 31, 2026 (see solicitation when available for specific time/date). 
Point of Contact: Gary Christensen, Contract Specialist, gary.christensen@va.gov. 
Questions regarding this notice may be submitted via e-mail to gary.christensen@va.gov.
